articles.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
articles.excerpt: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
articles.summary: 开源且完全本地运行的 ElevenLabs 替代方案，覆盖语音克隆、音色设计、视频配音、听写、转录与有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。模型与数据都不出本机，适合注重隐私、又想省下商业 TTS 订阅费的播客、视频团队和内容创作者自建语音流水线。

articles.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
articles.excerpt: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
articles.summary: NVIDIA 出品的自主 AI agent 安全运行时，为 agent 提供隔离、私有的执行环境，限制其对系统资源和数据的访问边界。适合在企业内网或本地部署 agent，又要求权限可控、数据不外泄的团队，作为 agent 落地的底层沙箱基础设施。

articles.title: vectorize-io/hindsight
articles.excerpt: Hindsight: Agent Memory That Learns
articles.summary: 面向 AI agent 的记忆层，让 agent 在长期交互中不断积累并学习经验，而不是每轮对话都从零开始。可用于多轮助手、自动化工作流等需要跨会话保持上下文、记住用户偏好的场景，减少重复说明与上下文丢失。

articles.title: paperclipai/paperclip
articles.excerpt: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
articles.summary: 用于在工作中管理 AI agent 的开源应用，把散落各处的 agent 集中到一个界面里调度、查看运行状态与产出结果。面向已把 agent 引入日常业务的团队，充当 agent 操作台，缓解多人协作时的可见性与管理混乱问题。

articles.title: t8y2/dbx
articles.excerpt: 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 100+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. Built-in AI, MCP Server, CLI, desktop and Docker. | 轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、达梦等 100+ 数据库，提供桌面端、Docker、CLI、内置 AI 助手和
articles.summary: 仅 25 MB 的轻量跨平台数据库客户端，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、DuckDB、SQL Server、达梦等 100 多种数据库，内置 AI 助手、MCP Server 与命令行，同时提供桌面端和 Dock 形态，适合需要在一个工具里连接多种数据源的开发者。

articles.title: mvschwarz/openrig
articles.excerpt: Multi-agent harness that runs Claude Code and Codex together as one system
articles.summary: 多 agent 编排框架，把 Claude Code 与 Codex 组合成同一套系统协同运行，让不同编码 agent 分工执行或互相校验。适合希望突破单一 agent 能力上限、在复杂编码任务上做并行处理与交叉验证的开发者。

articles.title: oblien/openship
articles.excerpt: Self-hosted deployment platform
articles.summary: 自托管部署平台，把应用的构建与发布流程放在自己的服务器上运行，不依赖第三方托管服务。适合关注数据主权和长期成本、希望像用 Vercel 那样一键发布、又要求完全自主可控的团队与独立开发者。

articles.title: averygan/reclip
articles.excerpt: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
articles.summary: 轻量级自托管媒体下载器，支持从几乎任意网站抓取视频，自带简洁的 Web 界面，部署在自己的服务器上即可使用。适合需要批量保存视频素材、又不想依赖第三方在线下载站点的用户和内容团队。

articles.title: cs341-illinois/coursebook
articles.excerpt: Open Source Introductory Systems Programming Textbook for the University of Illinois
articles.summary: 伊利诺伊大学 CS341 课程开源的系统编程入门教材，讲解底层系统编程的核心概念与实践方法。面向计算机专业学生和自学系统方向的工程师，可作为操作系统、并发、内存管理等课程的配套阅读材料。

articles.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
articles.excerpt: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
articles.summary: 一套从零开始的 AI 工程学习资料，按「先学会、再动手构建、最后交付给别人用」的路径组织内容，帮助开发者把模型能力真正做成可上线的产品。适合想系统补齐 AI 工程实践能力的软件工程师。

articles.title: VectifyAI/PageIndex

articles.summary: 为 RAG 设计的文档索引方案，不用向量检索，而是靠推理方式定位文档中的相关内容，省去 embedding 与向量库带来的误差和运维成本。适合处理长文档、专业资料检索问答的开发者与知识库团队。

articles.title: willfaust/Madeira

articles.title: dream-num/univer

articles.title: Is your domain using post-quantum encryption? Now you can see for yourself
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare has added visibility into post-quantum (PQ) encryption in TLS 1.3 directly into HTTP Analytics, Log Explorer, and Logpush. Learn how to make sure your domain is protected with PQ encryption.

articles.title: Enforce positive security with Cloudflare Application Profiles
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare learns the structure of your HTTP requests and identifies deviations. You can add a positive security layer that helps reduce attack surface as AI makes it easier for attackers to generate and vary payloads.

articles.title: Preventing quantum downgrade attacks against IPsec
articles.excerpt: A sophisticated attacker with a quantum computer can exploit a protocol design flaw to downgrade post-quantum IPsec tunnels to classical crypto. We helped the IETF develop a transcript authentication extension to prevent these attacks.

articles.title: Introducing cf: the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API
articles.excerpt: We are releasing cf, our new command-line tool that mirrors the entire Cloudflare API and supports programmatic TypeScript configuration. We are also open-sourcing Forge, our internal SDK generator.

articles.title: Next.js applications, powered by Vite: introducing Vinext 1.0
articles.excerpt: Vinext 1.0 graduates from an AI experiment to a production-ready framework, letting developers run Next.js apps on Vite. This release brings advanced cache warming, broader compatibility, and an automated testing pipeline.

articles.title: How fast is the web? Explore billions of real-user measurements with BEACON
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is open-sourcing the BEACON dataset, making billions of anonymized Real User Monitoring (RUM) performance records publicly available on Google BigQuery. Explore real-world Core Web Vitals, soft navigation metrics, and performance breakdowns across browsers and regions.

articles.title: Four months of VoidZero at Cloudflare: making the open-source JavaScript toolchain faster for all humans and agents
articles.excerpt: Since joining Cloudflare, VoidZero has delivered more than 80 releases that drastically speed up JavaScript compilation, linting, and testing. From a 10x faster React compiler to Vite+ 1.0, here’s how we are building faster tools for developers and AI agents.

articles.title: Introducing Forge: the open source pipeline for generating SDKs, CLIs, docs, and more
articles.excerpt: Forge is a pluggable, open-source pipeline that runs in CI to generate SDKs, CLIs, and documentation directly from API definitions. By shifting generation upstream into individual team repositories, Forge keeps developer tools continuously in sync.

articles.title: The road to the agentic browser: A Kitesurf update
articles.excerpt: We’ve updated Kitesurf, our Workers-based browser for AI agents, with WebMCP support, improved DOM performance, and terminal-based rendering. With over 730,000 Web Platform subtests passing, agents can now navigate complex sites faster.

articles.title: Introducing The Cold Start: pitch your startup live at Cloudflare Connect
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is launching The Cold Start, a startup competition giving five early-stage companies five minutes on stage at Cloudflare Connect. Grand Prize winner receives $500,000 in credits, a San Francisco billboard, and an invitation to our VIP speakers dinner.

articles.title: EmDash 1.0: the stable CMS with a secure plugin registry
articles.excerpt: EmDash 1.0 is a stable, open source CMS built for Astro, with agent-friendly workflows, secure sandboxed plugins, and a decentralized registry that keeps publishers in control.

articles.title: Supporting native Rust in Workers with the new Emscripten target for wasm-bindgen

articles.title: Cloudflare’s 2026 Annual Founders’ Letter
